verdict.rationale: RudderStack's API docs describe public APIs for programmatically managing connections, transformations and libraries, running Reverse ETL syncs, accessing audit logs, getting usage metrics, suppressing user data, and sending events via the HTTP API. Together these let a user drive the product rather than only send data into it. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the management API, and evidence on authentication and coverage of full workspace configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Explore the RudderStack APIs to programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features.
